title: Customer Portal Breach Attempt Report

sections.heading: 2. Description
sections.body: The customer portal saw credential-stuffing traffic over a two hour window. See Figure 2 for the botnet distribution.

sections.heading: 3. Timeline
sections.body: Anomalous login alarm at 22:58 UTC; surge 23:05 UTC; contained after WAF rate-limiting at 05:10 UTC.

sections.heading: 4. Contributing Factors
sections.body: Auth-gateway 3.5.2 was running on the affected service. Rate limiting was absent.
